definitions.explanation: To express approval or admiration for someone or their actions.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}に{褒|ほ}められた。
examples.english: I was praised by the teacher.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{褒|ほ}めて{育|そだ}てる。
よく{頑張|がんば}ったね。{褒|ほ}めてあげる。
examples.english: You worked hard. I'll praise you.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{褒|ほ}める (praise X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing or repeated action. {褒|ほ}めている = 'is praising.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{人|ひと}を{褒|ほ}める (praise someone)
・{褒|ほ}められる (be praised—passive)
・{褒|ほ}めて{育|そだ}てる (raise with praise)
・{褒|ほ}め{言葉|ことば} (compliment, words of praise)
・お{世辞|せじ}で{褒|ほ}める (flatter)

OPPOSITE: {叱|しか}る (to scold)

KANJI NOTE: Can also be written as {誉|ほ}める, but {褒|ほ}める is more common.

REGISTER: Neutral.
